title: ModuleTaskWorkerService
responsibility: Check machine readiness before claiming queued module work, run each claim in an isolated worktree with quota-only fallback, and preserve its result for review.

inputs.name: ModuleTaskWorkerService.constructor.root
inputs.description: Repository root that Git commands, the task queue, task worktrees and the analytics sync are bound to. Defaults to process.cwd(), read when the worker is constructed without a root.

inputs.name: ModuleTaskWorkerService.constructor.runner
inputs.description: The runner whose run(input) executes each attempt with its provider, model, intelligence, worktree cwd, prompt and signal. Defaults to new ModuleTaskRunnerAdapter(), which runs the installed provider CLIs with saved login.

inputs.name: ModuleTaskWorkerService.once.worker
inputs.description: Name recorded as the claim's worker and matched against task assignees; once() throws before touching the queue unless it matches ^[a-z0-9]+(?:[.-][a-z0-9]+)*$. Only queued tasks with no assignee or with this exact assignee can be claimed.

inputs.name: ModuleTaskWorkerService.once.modules
inputs.description: Restricts the claim to queued tasks whose module.id is listed; the default empty list leaves every module eligible. A module that already has a running task is skipped whatever this list contains.

inputs.name: ModuleTaskWorkerService.once.signal
inputs.description: Abort signal given to the runner as TaskRunInput.signal; the quota fallback checks it with throwIfAborted() before dispatching again. Defaults to AbortSignal.timeout(900000), which aborts after 900000 ms (15 minutes).

inputs.name: pendingTaskResult.selection
inputs.description: The provider, model and intelligence the attempt runs with, as resolved from the task by taskSelection; pendingTaskResult copies these fields into the result unchanged. An auto task always resolves to claude-haiku-5-5 at medium intelligence.

inputs.name: pendingTaskResult.worktree
inputs.description: Absolute path of the attempt's detached Git worktree, which taskWorkspace names with the claim token under .cache/harness/task-worktrees. It is stored unchanged as the result's worktree and passed to the runner as cwd.

inputs.name: claimedTask.queue
inputs.description: The queue snapshot that claimedTask edits inside repository.update; it marks the first eligible queued task as running with a claim, and the queue is committed only when that edit changed it.

features.goal: Let foreground workers take module tasks without racing each other.
features.tldr: Atomic claims, isolated worktrees, reviewed output.

inputs.name: claimedTask.worker
inputs.description: Worker name matched against each task's assignee and written into the new claim. The queue schema requires it to match the unit id pattern, so a name that does not match fails the queue update.

inputs.name: claimedTask.modules
inputs.description: Module ids a claim may take; an empty array leaves every module eligible. A module that already has a running task is skipped whatever this array contains.

inputs.name: claimedTask.owner
inputs.description: Identity of the clone and process making the claim, from repository.owner(): the workspace UUID, this process's pid and its ps start time. It is stored unchanged on the claim, and its startedAt must be a non-empty string.

inputs.name: claimedTask.runnable
inputs.description: The task ids that passed preflight on this machine. When omitted, every otherwise eligible task can run.

inputs.name: finishTask.queue
inputs.description: The queue snapshot that finishTask edits inside repository.update; it finds the task by id and writes status and result only when the stored task still matches the claimed copy.

errors.name: Invalid worker, stale claim, or delegated task failure
errors.description: Explicit throws: an invalid worker name in once(), a finish whose stored task no longer matches the claim, and changed paths outside the module or a HEAD that differs from the source commit. Owner lookup, queue updates, task preparation and workspace setup reject with their own errors, while runner, worktree and snapshot failures are recorded in result.error instead.

inputs.name: ModuleTaskWorkerService.constructor.root
inputs.description: Repository root that Git commands, the task queue, task worktrees and the analytics sync are bound to. Defaults to process.cwd(), read when the worker is constructed without a root.

inputs.name: ModuleTaskWorkerService.constructor.runner
inputs.description: The runner whose run(input) executes each attempt with its provider, model, intelligence, worktree cwd, prompt and signal. Defaults to new ModuleTaskRunnerAdapter(), which runs the installed provider CLIs with saved login.

outputs.name: ModuleTaskWorkerService.constructor
outputs.description: The new ModuleTaskWorkerService, whose repository is a ModuleTaskRepository bound to root.

errors.name: Worker current directory unavailable
errors.description: Thrown only when root is omitted and the default process.cwd() fails because the working directory no longer exists (Node reports an ENOENT error from uv_cwd). Building the default ModuleTaskRunnerAdapter and the ModuleTaskRepository, which builds a GitAdapter, only stores fields and throws nothing.
